SAMPLE SIZE.evidence_source: Ellis (1926) used entry in the Dictionary of National Biography as a measure of eminence in an early study of 1,030 British luminaries. The sample size for Study X (Ellis, 1926) is 1030.

Number of studies.evidence_source: The text mentions three distinct research efforts as examples: Ellis (1926), Colangelo and colleagues (1992), and Simonton (1980).

section_summary.extract_value: This section describes various methods used to measure eminence or achievement. It provides examples from three different studies: Ellis (1926) used entry in the Dictionary of National Biography for 1,030 British luminaries, Colangelo and colleagues (1992) used the number of patents, and Simonton (1980) counted musical composition recordings.
